## Sculptor’s Bench

Open 3D Studio, describe an object, and choose **Create 3D model**. Workbench draws a local reference image, reconstructs a colored mesh with TripoSR, and saves it. Drag to rotate the model or export a GLB. The bundled red panda is a rotatable example. Creation uses the image and 3D runtimes in the connected workspace.

The new page shows progress and reconnects to a running request when you return. Completed requests reopen their original model. The viewer and exported GLB share corrected surface orientation and linear vertex colors. Earlier editable scenes remain available in the model library.

The packaged Windows app generated a cobalt-blue owl from text in approximately 33 seconds on an RTX 3060. The result had 26176 triangles. The verified preview and exported GLB matched, rotating the model changed the visible angle, and replaying the request returned the same saved model. Checked three window sizes and four native tests for generation and earlier saved designs.
